characterAnchors.note: Enters, clears, heals, teaches, predicts destruction, speaks of his body, and is remembered through temple events.

concept.throughline: A commanded tent becomes an ordered place of approach; the ark and glory enter a built house; that house is prayed toward, neglected, profaned, destroyed, rebuilt, and rededicated; Jesus acts and is disputed within the temple; later texts apply building language to body and community, compare earthly and heavenly sanctuary, and finally show a city with no separate temple.
